sentences.en: I believe that English sentences will always predominate on Tatoeba.
sentences.zh: 我认为英语句子在Tatoeba中将始终占据主导地位。

sentences.en: This book is predominated by dark and gloomy tone.
sentences.zh: 这本书主要弥漫着阴暗沉闷的基调。

sentences.en: Among the products of this region, cotton predominates.
sentences.zh: 该地区的产品以棉花为主导。

senses.zh: （数量上）占优势，占大多数；占主导地位，占支配地位； <罕>支配，主宰

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pre（前）+dominate（统治）→处于统治地位→占优势
